problem.problemStatement: The Zod playground has no visual representation of schema structure. Users write Zod schemas and test values but cannot see ER diagrams, class diagrams, or flowcharts of their schema relationships, making it harder to understand complex nested schemas at a glance.
problem.successOutcome: Users can click a Diagram tab in the right panel to see a Mermaid-rendered ER diagram (default), class diagram, or flowchart of their Zod 4 schema, with diagram type switching, dark mode support, and copy-to-clipboard for the Mermaid markup.
problem.costOfInaction: Users continue relying on mental parsing of schema code to understand structure; the playground misses an opportunity to differentiate through visual tooling.

knownIssues: No schema visualization exists — right panel only shows value validation

risks.description: jsDelivr +esm transform may fail for zod-mermaid due to deep imports or CommonJS internals that don't transpile cleanly to ESM
risks.mitigation: Test CDN URL manually before coding. Verify import resolves in browser devtools.
risks.fallback: Fall back to esm.sh CDN or bundle zod-mermaid as a last resort

risks.description: Cross-Zod-version duck typing may break if zod-mermaid uses instanceof checks instead of property-based checks against CDN-loaded Zod schemas
risks.mitigation: zod-mermaid uses .def.type property checks which are stable across Zod 4.x instances

risks.description: Mermaid dark mode rendering may produce illegible diagrams if theme initialization doesn't propagate correctly
risks.mitigation: Pass theme:'dark' to mermaid.initialize() based on Mantine useComputedColorScheme; re-render on scheme change

risks.description: Large schemas may produce unreadable diagrams that overflow the visible area
risks.mitigation: SVG container with overflow:auto scroll. Future enhancement: add zoom/pan controls.

risks.description: Primitive schemas (e.g. z.string()) produce trivial or empty diagrams that may confuse users
risks.mitigation: Show informational message for non-object schemas explaining that diagrams work best with object/record schemas

decisions.title: Load zod-mermaid and mermaid from CDN at runtime
decisions.chosen: CDN dynamic import via jsDelivr — both zod-mermaid and mermaid loaded at runtime, not bundled. This avoids cross-instance Zod instanceof failures and keeps the app bundle unchanged (~2MB mermaid stays out of bundle).

alternatives.option: Bundle zod-mermaid and mermaid as npm dependencies
alternatives.rejectionReason: zod-mermaid imports zod internally — bundled copy gets its own Zod instance, causing instanceof check failures against CDN-loaded schemas. Also adds ~2MB to bundle.

alternatives.option: Bundle zod-mermaid only, load mermaid from CDN
alternatives.rejectionReason: Still has the cross-instance Zod problem for zod-mermaid's internal zod import.

decisions.title: Use Tabs in right panel instead of third panel
decisions.chosen: Mantine Tabs component in the right panel toggles between Values and Diagram views. Minimal layout change; two-panel structure preserved.

alternatives.rejectionReason: Would crowd screens — each panel gets ~440px on 1440px. Users rarely need values and diagram simultaneously.
Breaks the side-by-side editing workflow. Diagram should feel integrated, not secondary.
